title: "Single-cell QC Acceptance Report"
output: html_document

# Reproducible QC Summary

This report uses the deterministic acceptance dataset and exercises chunk
navigation, execution, rendering, plots, and output provenance.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
report_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)))
project_root <- dirname(report_dir)
input_path <- file.path(project_root, "data", "cell-qc.csv")
if (!file.exists(input_path)) {
  old_dir <- setwd(project_root)
  on.exit(setwd(old_dir), add = TRUE)
  source(file.path("examples", "single-cell-qc", "01-generate-qc-data.R"))
}
cell_qc <- read.csv(input_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

## Dataset

```{r dataset-summary}
dim(cell_qc)
summary(cell_qc[c("n_features", "total_counts", "mito_percent", "doublet_score")])
```

## QC Decision

```{r qc-decision}
cell_qc$qc_pass <- with(
  cell_qc,
  n_features >= 300 & n_features <= 4500 &
    mito_percent <= 20 & doublet_score <= 0.30
)
table(cell_qc$sample_id, cell_qc$qc_pass)
```

## Diagnostic Plot

```{r qc-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
plot(
  cell_qc$n_features,
  cell_qc$total_counts,
  col = ifelse(cell_qc$qc_pass, "#257a56", "#c54343"),
  pch = 16,
  xlab = "Detected features",
  ylab = "Total counts"
)
```
